description: This file defines API endpoints for A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol, enabling clients to invoke agents through LiteLLM using FastAPI. It includes route handlers for retrieving agent cards, sending messages, and streaming responses, leveraging JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol for communication. The file interacts with agent registry and permission modules, and utilizes various helper functions to handle errors, authorization, and request pre-processing.

methods.name: JSONResponse _jsonrpc_error( request_id: Optional[str], code: int, message: str, status_code: int = 400, )
methods.description: Creates a JSON-RPC 2.0 error response with a specified code, message, and HTTP status.

methods.name: _get_agent(agent_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an agent object by ID or name from the global registry, returning None if not found.

methods.name: StreamingResponse _handle_stream_message( api_base: Optional[str], request_id: str, params: dict, litellm_params: Optional[dict] = None, agent_id: Optional[str] = None, metadata: Optional[dict] = None, proxy_server_request: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Handles streaming message requests by invoking the asynchronous streaming function and managing exceptions.

methods.name: get_agent_card( agent_id: str, request: Request, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve agent card information for discovery, with permission checks and URL rewriting.

methods.name: invoke_agent_a2a( agent_id: str, request: Request, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Main endpoint to invoke an agent via JSON-RPC, supporting message sending and streaming, with thorough validation and error handling.
